name: Mezőszentgyörgy (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Mezőszentgyörgy (a crowned blue shield with a yellow lion, with a helm, a bird crest and red and white mantling) above the name MEZŐSZENTGYÖRGY in black.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Mezőszentgyörgy arms with crown, helm, crest and mantling
